MM50 = 29.8636
MM200 = 29.1706

EMA21 = 30.3110
BB_lower = 28.9291
BB_mid = 30.1680
BB_upper = 31.4069
MACD = 0.2840
MACD_signal = 0.2685
MACD_hist = 0.0156
RSI14 = 51.8053
volume = 3039495900

width = BB_upper - BB_lower
rel_width = width / BB_mid * 100
dist_to_mid = close - BB_mid
pct_to_mid = dist_to_mid / BB_mid * 100

pct_above_MM20 = above_MM20 / MM20 * 100
above_MM50 = close - MM50
pct_above_MM50 = above_MM50 / MM50 * 100
above_MM200 = close - MM200
pct_above_MM200 = above_MM200 / MM200 * 100

print(f'BB_rel_width_pct = {rel_width:.2f}%')

print('Done')
"} }
